title: Two filter arguments on different columns of the same table both apply

source.quote: When there are multiple filters, they're evaluated by using the AND logical operator
source.supports: multiple filters must all be true at the same time

source.quote: If two or more filters are applied to columns in the same table, they are considered under a logical AND condition
source.supports: filters on two columns of one table restrict it to the rows satisfying both

derivation: Red and Accessories: only Helmet (2). Sales rows 2, 3 = 40 + 20 = 60.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
